_comment: Skills this workflow uses, by group. Bodies are not vendored: each entry points at its upstream source. `use` says who calls it: a role (architect, builder, escalation, review, docs) through skills-manifest.json, or `human` for skills you invoke yourself (`invocation: user` means the model cannot load it). Install targets Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode together. Stack-specific rule skills are intentionally excluded.

obsolete.grill-me: duplicate of grilling for this workflow

skills.name: grilling
skills.description: Interview loop: facts from the code, decisions from the user one at a time.

skills.name: domain-modeling
skills.description: Pin domain vocabulary in GLOSSARY.md and record decisions as ADRs.

skills.name: codebase-design
skills.description: Deep-module vocabulary: seams, interface depth, information hiding.

skills.name: prototype
skills.description: Throwaway prototype to answer a behaviour or UI question by seeing it.

skills.name: research
skills.description: Primary-source research written to a Markdown file in the repo.

skills.name: architect
skills.description: Full design workflow: ground (how/why), sketch types and modules before code, design twice via arena, implement against the sketch, scrap when wrong. /plan embeds its method; run this for designs that need the full multi-candidate treatment.

skills.name: wayfinder
skills.description: Chart work too large for one session as a map of investigation tickets.

skills.name: improve-codebase-architecture
skills.description: Find deepening opportunities and grill through the one you pick.

skills.name: tdd
skills.description: Red-green-refactor at the seams the spec agreed.

skills.name: diagnosing-bugs
skills.description: Reproduce, minimise, hypothesise, fix: used before a Builder escalates.

skills.name: code-review
skills.description: Standards and Spec axes reviewed independently.

skills.name: pr
skills.description: PR body: summary visual, before/after evidence, merge-danger call.

skills.name: retro
skills.description: After a session: improve the agent's environment, not the code.

tracker.label: Issue-tracker flow (optional; Role Router itself uses PLAN.md)

skills.description: Publish the conversation as a spec on the issue tracker.

skills.name: to-tickets
skills.description: Publish tracer-bullet tickets with blocking edges to the tracker.

skills.name: triage
skills.description: Move issues through triage states and write agent-ready briefs.

skills.name: setup-matt-pocock-skills
skills.description: Configure tracker, labels and doc layout for the tracker skills.

skills.name: find-skills
skills.description: Discover installable skills.

pstack.label: pstack · design, investigation, verification (you invoke these)

skills.name: arena
skills.description: Fan out N candidates at one task, pick a base, graft the best of the rest.

skills.name: interrogate
skills.description: Adversarial multi-model review of a change; synthesised verdict.

skills.name: how
skills.description: How a subsystem works: traced runtime flow, ownership, placement.

skills.name: why
skills.description: Why code is shaped the way it is, from history, issues and docs.

skills.name: blast-radius

skills.name: maintain-verification-skill
skills.description: Keep a generated verification skill's feature map honest.

skills.name: unslop
skills.description: Strip AI-sounding prose from writing (used by blast-radius write-ups).
